items.hook: A Spy of Napoleon is a 1934 historical novel by the British writer Baroness Emmuska Orczy.
items.body: An illegitimate daughter of Louis Napoleon is taken on as an agent by Napoleon III, ruler of France, who wishes her to marry into and spy on the aristocracy who he suspects of wanting to overthrow him. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.
